## WF3 follow-up scheduler
Runs hourly. Cadence: warm 1/3/7 days, cold 3/7 days (WF2 sets follow-up 1). Counters advance BEFORE the send so a crash cannot double-message a lead. Sandbox limit: free-form sends only within 24h of the last inbound message, otherwise the lead is parked and Slack is alerted.
